subject.title: feat(google-meet): retain the full caption transcript per session (#103387)

question: After automatic caption draining is fixed, should post-meeting transcripts intentionally remain volatile gateway memory with a 2000-line cap and four-ended-session retention window?
rationale: The linked request permits gateway accumulation, but restart loss and ended-session eviction determine whether the public post-meeting retrieval promise is acceptable; repository policy requires an owner decision rather than treating persistence semantics as implementation convenience.

options.title: Accept bounded volatile retention
options.body: Land the repaired API with explicit restart, cap, and ended-session eviction documentation and live proof.

options.title: Require SQLite durability
options.body: Delay post-meeting retrieval until transcript state uses an appropriate SQLite-backed owner and survives gateway restarts.

options.title: Limit to active sessions
options.body: Expose incremental retrieval only while the meeting is active and defer the post-meeting contract.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded volatile retention
recommendation.body: Land the repaired API with explicit restart, cap, and ended-session eviction documentation and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin introduction and caption-health history make this person the strongest available owner for the Google Meet transcript lifetime contract.
